product_overview: A simple e-commerce web app for browsing, purchasing, and managing products with simulated authentication and checkout, running fully locally without external services.
core_goals: Enable users to browse and view product details easily.
Allow users to log in with a hardcoded test account.
Support simulated product purchasing and order history tracking.
Provide an admin interface for managing products, orders, and users (demo purposes).
Ensure all data is stored and processed locally with no external dependencies.
key_features: User authentication via hardcoded test account.
Product catalog with name, description, image, price, and category.
Simulated checkout process with order history recording.
Order history page showing users' past purchases.
Node.js backend exposing REST API for products, orders, and purchasing.
Frontend with React implementing all user pages and flows.
Local data storage using JSON files or in-memory for demo purposes.
user_flow_summary: Visitor browses product catalog and views product details without logging in.
User logs in using the test account with email and password.
User selects product and performs simulated purchase; order is recorded.
User views order history listing all purchased products.
Admin logs in to access admin page for product management (optional).
validation_criteria: User can successfully log in only with the hardcoded test account credentials.
Product catalog loads correctly showing all product fields.
Simulated checkout adds purchased product to user's order history.
Order history page reflects correct purchase data for the logged-in user.
Admin can add, edit, and delete products via admin interface.
All functionality works fully locally without external service calls.
Frontend routes correctly between catalog, product details, login, order history, and admin pages.
Backend REST API endpoints respond with correct data for products, orders, and purchases.
